answer_1.quote: We conduct a series of experiments and analysis, aiming to answer... the primary objective of our research is to examine the potential of modifying T2I prompts with GPT-k models... We modify the T2I prompts with eight GPT-k models.

answer_2.quote: We use the cosine similarity of CLIP-ViT/B-32 visual features to evaluate the similarity between images... We also employed the following metrics to evaluate the similarity between images: (1) SSIM (2) PSNR.

answer_4.quote: We recruited Amazon Mechanical Turk annotators to conduct human evaluations... annotators are then asked to decide which edit was more effective and more likely to be adopted by human editors.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two candidate edits (GPT-k-modified prompt vs. human edit) and judge which is more effective and more likely to be adopted.
